about.registryInfo: Ctrl Alt Solutions FZCO, Dubai (DMCC199928; VARA VASP licence VL/25/05/002, Broker-Dealer + Issuer; UK affiliate Ctrl Alt Ltd, FCA FRN 1045023). Tokenized representation of Billiton Diamond's GIA-certified polished diamond inventory (~AED 1bn / $280M program) with custody via Ripple's enterprise custody technology. Explicitly a controlled pilot: investor distribution requires further VARA approval; 100% of each collection is held by a single inventory account.
